subject: Sam Laidlow
editorial: KONA.m independent room. Results only; taglines are KONA.m copy, not the athlete's words.

coach.line: Coached by his father, Richard Laidlow.

results.note: First IRONMAN World Champion from France and the youngest man ever to win the title.
Bike course record, more than four minutes under the 2018 mark.
Described by Canyon as a long-distance triathlon world record, on the then-unreleased Speedmax CFR.

equipment.line: A Canyon athlete since January 2023 (Speedmax CFR).
equipment.room_model: The room shows the KONA.m museum's canonical Canyon Speedmax CFR (assets/museum/speedmax_web.glb) in its documented finish: the model line Laidlow races, not the actual race bike, livery or setup.

rights.brand_marks: Canyon wordmarks appear only as modelled on the canonical museum asset
